intro.text: Brightlord Yezriar, crown prince of one of the Alethi princedoms that resists Gavilar Kholin's war of unification.

items.text: When Gavilar invaded his father's princedom, the locals set their own land on fire to slow the attack. Dalinar pressed through the fires and caught up with part of the defending army, led by Yezriar.

Dalinar wanted to kill the most important person he could find. As Yezriar's defences broke, he accepted Dalinar's challenge to a duel. Jenin shot Yezriar's horse, but he recovered, and when one of Dalinar's shield straps broke he landed several blows, including a gauntleted punch to Dalinar's face.

Dying, Yezriar asked why Dalinar had attacked, and was surprised that Dalinar didn't know and had simply followed Gavilar's orders. Dalinar had Dym finish him through a gap in his armour, to discourage other lighteyes from resisting Gavilar. Yezriar's father was also killed in the fighting.
Many years afterwards, Yezriar's death was among the memories Odium stirred up in Dalinar's mind. Dalinar thought Yezriar a better man than himself.

appearance.text: In battle he wears steel plate with a helm and cape styled to look like Shardplate, rides a white mare and carries sword and shield, with an honour guard around him.
